_comment: A fixed, deterministic set of test-split images for export parity (Lesson 04, step 6). Paths are relative to the project root. data/v1 is gitignored (versioned in Roboflow, not git) — this file commits the LIST, not the binaries, so `tests/test_export_parity.py` is reproducible on any machine that has run the Lesson 03 dataset steps, and skips cleanly (not fails) when it has not.
